metadata.title: Intelligent Interaction Design x Robotics HRI Knowledge Graph Sample
metadata.scope: HRI-oriented design research, knowledge graph reuse, portfolio ideation
metadata.note: Seed graph, not exhaustive. Evidence links point to literature/source registry.

nodes.label: Human-Robot Interaction
nodes.definition: 研究人与机器人之间的物理、认知、社会和组织互动。
nodes.design_relevance: 作为整个知识图谱的中心学科。

nodes.label: Human-Computer Interaction
nodes.definition: 研究人与计算系统的交互体验、方法和社会影响。

nodes.label: Robotics
nodes.definition: 研究能感知、决策并在物理世界行动的系统。

nodes.label: Design Research
nodes.definition: 通过研究方法和设计实践生成设计知识。

nodes.label: Human Factors
nodes.definition: 研究人类能力、限制和系统绩效之间的关系。

nodes.label: Embodied AI
nodes.definition: 关注智能体在环境中的感知、行动和 grounding。
nodes.design_relevance: 连接 AI 与机器人实际行动。

nodes.label: Intelligent Interaction Design
nodes.definition: 面向具备感知、推理、学习或自主能力系统的交互设计。

nodes.label: Embodied Interaction
nodes.definition: 行动、身体、空间和情境共同构成交互意义。
nodes.design_relevance: 帮助设计师关注机器人身体和动作。

nodes.label: Situated Action
nodes.definition: 行动不是计划的机械执行，而是在情境中不断调整。

nodes.label: Levels of Automation
nodes.definition: 自动化可分布在信息获取、分析、决策和行动等功能中。

nodes.label: Research through Design
nodes.definition: 设计产物和反思可以生成 HCI/设计研究知识。

nodes.label: Robot Autonomy
nodes.definition: 机器人独立感知、决策和行动的程度。
nodes.design_relevance: 决定控制权和责任分配。

nodes.label: Shared Autonomy
nodes.definition: 人与机器人共同完成控制和决策。
nodes.design_relevance: 适合远程操作、辅助控制和复杂服务任务。

nodes.label: Human Agency
nodes.definition: 用户保有选择、控制和影响系统行为的能力感。

nodes.label: Trust Calibration
nodes.definition: 让用户信任程度匹配机器人真实能力。
nodes.design_relevance: HRI 设计不能只追求更高信任。

nodes.label: Transparency
nodes.definition: 系统状态、逻辑、边界和不确定性可被用户理解的程度。
nodes.design_relevance: 支持接管、责任和信任校准。

nodes.label: Explainability
nodes.definition: 机器人或 AI 给出与任务相关的理由、限制和不确定性。
nodes.design_relevance: 连接 LLM agent 与 HRI 责任。

nodes.label: Legible Motion
nodes.definition: 机器人动作能让人快速推断目标。
nodes.design_relevance: 对协作机器人和公共空间机器人非常关键。

nodes.label: Predictability
nodes.definition: 机器人行为符合用户预期。

nodes.label: Situation Awareness
nodes.definition: 用户理解当前环境、意义和未来变化。

nodes.label: Social Presence
nodes.definition: 机器人被感知为社会参与者的程度。

nodes.label: Anthropomorphism
nodes.definition: 用户将人类特质归因给机器人。

nodes.label: Failure Recovery
nodes.definition: 系统识别、解释并补救失败的能力。
nodes.design_relevance: 决定服务体验是否有韧性。

nodes.label: Multimodal Feedback
nodes.definition: 通过视觉、语音、触觉、动作等多通道反馈状态和意图。

nodes.label: Affordance
nodes.definition: 环境或系统向行动者提供的可行动可能。
nodes.design_relevance: 帮助解释机器人任务可执行性。

nodes.label: Role Allocation
nodes.definition: 在人、AI 和机器人之间划分任务、权限和责任。

nodes.label: GraphRAG
nodes.definition: 结合图谱关系和文档检索进行 LLM 推理与生成。
nodes.design_relevance: 本知识库的长期复用方式。

nodes.label: Wizard-of-Oz Prototyping
nodes.definition: 由人隐藏控制机器人或智能表现来测试交互。
nodes.design_relevance: 适合本科阶段快速验证 HRI 概念。

nodes.label: Participatory Design
nodes.definition: 让用户和利益相关者参与问题定义和方案生成。

nodes.label: Contextual Inquiry
nodes.definition: 在真实场景中观察并询问使用者。

nodes.label: Controlled Experiment
nodes.definition: 操纵变量并测量因果影响。

nodes.label: Longitudinal Study
nodes.definition: 研究长期使用、关系和采纳。

nodes.label: Research through Design
nodes.definition: 通过原型、反思和注释作品集生成知识。

nodes.label: AR/MR Interface
nodes.definition: 用增强或混合现实显示机器人路径、状态和风险。
nodes.design_relevance: 把不可见计划转成可见线索。

nodes.label: LLM Agent Layer
nodes.definition: 在用户语言和机器人可执行动作之间进行解释、规划和澄清。

nodes.label: Perception
nodes.definition: 通过传感器理解人、物体和环境。

nodes.label: Navigation
nodes.definition: 机器人在空间中定位、规划路径并移动。

nodes.label: Motion Planning
nodes.definition: 生成安全、可执行并可理解的运动。

nodes.label: Intention Recognition
nodes.definition: 推断人或机器人目标。

nodes.label: Haptic Feedback
nodes.definition: 通过力或震动反馈状态。

nodes.label: Speech Interface
nodes.definition: 支持语音命令、反馈和澄清。

nodes.label: Gesture Recognition
nodes.definition: 识别人类手势和指向。

nodes.label: Voice Interaction
nodes.definition: 通过语音命令和对话互动。

nodes.label: Gesture Interaction
nodes.definition: 通过手势、身体动作或指向互动。

nodes.label: Gaze Interaction
nodes.definition: 通过视线和共同注意互动。

nodes.label: Haptic Interaction
nodes.definition: 通过触觉反馈和接触互动。

nodes.label: Tangible Interaction
nodes.definition: 通过实体物件和空间布局互动。

nodes.label: Visual AR Feedback
nodes.definition: 用 AR 视觉元素展示状态、路径和风险。

nodes.label: Service Robot
nodes.definition: 在服务场景为人或组织执行任务的机器人。

nodes.label: Social Robot
nodes.definition: 以社会交互为关键功能的机器人。

nodes.label: Collaborative Robot
nodes.definition: 与人共享工作空间协同工作的机器人。

nodes.label: Mobile Manipulator
nodes.definition: 结合移动底盘和机械臂的机器人。

nodes.label: Telepresence Robot
nodes.definition: 支持远程在场和操作的机器人。

nodes.label: Hotel Delivery
nodes.definition: 机器人在酒店中执行送物、通知和引导。

nodes.label: Hospital Guidance
nodes.definition: 机器人在医院中提供导航、排队和信息说明。

nodes.label: Elderly Care
nodes.definition: 机器人支持提醒、陪伴和护理协作。

nodes.label: Industrial Assembly
nodes.definition: 人与协作机器人共同完成装配。

nodes.label: Public Space Cleaning
nodes.definition: 机器人在人群共享空间执行清洁任务。

nodes.label: Home Assistant
nodes.definition: 机器人在家庭环境完成提醒、清洁和轻服务。

nodes.label: Museum Guide
nodes.definition: 机器人在展馆中讲解、引导和答疑。

nodes.label: Rehabilitation Training
nodes.definition: 机器人辅助患者进行身体训练。

nodes.label: Remote Inspection
nodes.definition: 操作者远程监督机器人巡检。

nodes.label: Usability
nodes.definition: 衡量任务效率、效果和满意度。

nodes.label: Trust
nodes.definition: 衡量用户对机器人能力和可靠性的依赖。

nodes.label: Workload
nodes.definition: 衡量认知、身体和时间负荷。

nodes.label: Acceptance
nodes.definition: 衡量用户采纳和使用意愿。

nodes.label: Safety
nodes.definition: 衡量物理和心理风险控制。

nodes.label: Situation Awareness
nodes.definition: 衡量用户对当前和未来状态的理解。

nodes.label: Social Presence
nodes.definition: 衡量机器人被感知为社会参与者的程度。

nodes.label: Perceived Intelligence
nodes.definition: 衡量用户认为机器人聪明和有能力的程度。

nodes.label: Error Recovery
nodes.definition: 衡量失败后的解释、修复和恢复表现。

nodes.label: AR Path and Intent Guidance
nodes.zh_label: AR 路径与意图可视化
nodes.definition: 通过 AR/MR 展示机器人路径、目标和风险区域。
nodes.portfolio_potential: 适合做可视化原型和对比实验。

nodes.label: Service Robot Failure Recovery
nodes.zh_label: 服务机器人失败恢复体验
nodes.definition: 设计机器人失败时的解释、补救和人工转接。

nodes.label: LLM-Robot Mediator
nodes.zh_label: LLM 机器人任务协商中间层
nodes.definition: 用 LLM 把自然语言需求转成可执行、可确认的机器人任务。

nodes.label: Cobot Intent UI
nodes.definition: 显示机械臂下一步动作、目标和安全区。

nodes.label: How does autonomy affect trust and control?
nodes.zh_label: 自主性如何影响信任与控制感？
nodes.definition: 研究不同自主性等级对信任、控制感和责任归属的影响。

nodes.label: Does AR improve robot intent understanding?
nodes.zh_label: AR 是否提升机器人意图理解？
nodes.definition: 比较 AR 路径提示与传统状态提示的效果。

nodes.label: Goodrich and Schultz 2007
nodes.definition: HRI survey source.

nodes.label: Bartneck et al. 2009
nodes.definition: Godspeed measurement source.

nodes.label: Lasota et al. 2017
nodes.definition: Safe HRI survey source.

nodes.definition: VAM-HRI taxonomy source.

relations.description: HRI shares methods and theories with HCI.
relations.design_implication: HCI 方法可迁移到机器人交互。

relations.description: HRI connects interaction research with robotics systems.
relations.design_implication: 设计需要理解机器人能力边界。

relations.description: HRI uses human factors metrics and safety thinking.
relations.design_implication: 信任、负荷、安全需要量化。

relations.description: Intelligent interaction design extends HCI toward AI-enabled systems.
relations.design_implication: 设计对象从界面扩展到智能行为。

relations.description: The design lens is applied to HRI problems.
relations.design_implication: 将 HRI 技术模块转译成体验问题。

relations.description: Embodied interaction is aligned with situated action.
relations.design_implication: 交互分析应包含现场行为。

relations.description: Affordance explains action possibilities in embodied contexts.
relations.design_implication: 设计机器人任务可供性。

relations.description: Robot autonomy can be analyzed through levels of automation.
relations.design_implication: 不要把自主性当成单一开关。

relations.description: Shared autonomy is a mode within autonomy design.
relations.design_implication: 适合可调控制权。

relations.description: Shared autonomy often needs inference of human goals.
relations.design_implication: 意图识别错误需要可恢复机制。

relations.description: When designed well, shared autonomy can preserve human agency.
relations.design_implication: 辅助强度需可调。

relations.description: Autonomy influences how users trust and rely on robots.
relations.design_implication: 需要信任校准而不是盲目信任。

relations.description: High autonomy may reduce perceived human control.
relations.design_implication: 设计接管和确认。

relations.description: Trust calibration refines the trust construct toward appropriate reliance.
relations.design_implication: 信任过高和过低都是风险。

relations.description: Transparency can help users form calibrated trust.
relations.design_implication: 说明系统能力和限制。

relations.description: Explanations support transparency when task-relevant.
relations.design_implication: 解释应围绕用户决策。

relations.description: Explanations can influence perceived trust.
relations.design_implication: 需要避免过度解释。

relations.description: Legibility and predictability are related but distinct motion qualities.
relations.design_implication: 意图清晰不等同于轨迹常规。

relations.description: Legible motion can improve perceived safety and coordination.
relations.design_implication: 让目标更易推断。

relations.description: Motion planning can optimize for legibility.
relations.design_implication: 规划目标需包含人类推断。

relations.description: AR/MR interfaces provide visual augmentation.
relations.design_implication: 可视化路径和安全区。

relations.description: AR can make robot state and plans visible.
relations.design_implication: 用于远程操作和协作工位。

relations.description: AR/MR can support collaborative workstations.
relations.design_implication: 显示安全区和下一步动作。

relations.description: AR concepts can support public understanding of robot paths.
relations.design_implication: 公共演示可用移动 AR。

relations.description: AR feedback can be evaluated through situation awareness.
relations.design_implication: 评估用户是否理解未来路径。

relations.description: LLM layer enables natural-language task mediation.
relations.design_implication: 必须加入可执行性和安全确认。

relations.description: LLM mediation introduces opacity and accountability issues.
relations.design_implication: 需要显示来源、计划和置信度。

relations.description: LLM robot plans must be grounded in robot affordances.
relations.design_implication: 把“能说”限制为“能做”。

relations.description: Embodied AI extends robotics with foundation model reasoning.
relations.design_implication: 前沿方向但需要标注证据成熟度。

relations.description: Service robots are used in hotel delivery.
relations.design_implication: 适合服务蓝图分析。

relations.description: Service robots can guide patients in hospitals.
relations.design_implication: 需要低负荷和隐私保护。

relations.description: Service robots operate in public cleaning scenarios.
relations.design_implication: 需要社会规范和状态表达。

relations.description: Social robots rely on social presence.
relations.design_implication: 设计社会线索要适度。

relations.description: Social robots often trigger anthropomorphism.
relations.design_implication: 避免过度拟人。

relations.description: Anthropomorphism relates to social perception measures.
relations.design_implication: 选择 Godspeed 维度时需说明原因。

relations.description: Godspeed includes perceived intelligence.
relations.design_implication: 社交机器人可用此量表。

relations.description: Godspeed supports social perception evaluation.
relations.design_implication: 可作为作品集评估工具。

relations.description: Cobots require safety evaluation.
relations.design_implication: 必须先考虑风险。

relations.description: Cobots are typical in industrial assembly.
relations.design_implication: 适合意图表达项目。

relations.description: Collaborative assembly requires understandable robot motion.
relations.design_implication: 降低惊吓与误判。

relations.description: Human and robot roles must be clear in collaborative tasks.
relations.design_implication: 用任务矩阵定义责任。

relations.description: Hotel service needs recovery when robots fail.
relations.design_implication: 服务失败是设计机会。

relations.description: Hotel robot experience can be evaluated by trust.
relations.design_implication: 关注用户是否愿意再次使用。

relations.description: Elderly care robots should be evaluated by acceptance.
relations.design_implication: 纳入社交和有用性变量。

relations.description: Elderly care robots require transparency about data and limits.
relations.design_implication: 避免误导和隐私焦虑。

relations.description: Remote inspection depends on operator situation awareness.
relations.design_implication: 界面要整合空间、风险、未来动作。

relations.description: Remote inspection can impose high workload.
relations.design_implication: 用 NASA-TLX 对比界面。

relations.description: Wizard-of-Oz is useful for social robot behavior prototyping.
relations.design_implication: 快速测试对话与表达。

relations.description: Wizard-of-Oz can simulate speech intelligence.
relations.design_implication: 避免早期开发成本。

relations.description: RtD method follows RtD theory.
relations.design_implication: 作品集可作为研究产物。

relations.description: RtD can explore AR path guidance concepts.
relations.design_implication: 通过原型生成知识。

relations.description: Contextual inquiry reveals hospital workflow constraints.
relations.design_implication: 先研究流程再设计机器人。

relations.description: Participatory design can involve older adults and caregivers.
relations.design_implication: 避免替用户想象需求。

relations.description: Controlled experiments can measure workload differences.
relations.design_implication: 用于多模态对比。

relations.description: Longitudinal studies reveal adoption over time.
relations.design_implication: 服务机器人不是一次性体验。

relations.description: HRI surveys emphasize task and interaction workload as issues.
relations.design_implication: 需结合 NASA-TLX 等工具。

relations.description: Workload is a human factors metric.
relations.design_implication: 评估认知负担。

relations.description: Trust is central in human factors automation research.
relations.design_implication: 用于自主系统评估。

relations.description: Situation awareness is a human factors construct.
relations.design_implication: 适合动态系统。

relations.description: Safe HRI survey structures safety methods.
relations.design_implication: 设计要映射风险控制。

relations.description: Lasota et al. survey safety methods.
relations.design_implication: 作为安全模块核心参考。

relations.description: Walker et al. propose VAM-HRI taxonomy.
relations.design_implication: 作为 AR/MR 模块核心参考。

relations.description: Goodrich and Schultz provide HRI survey.
relations.design_implication: 作为主报告背景引用。

relations.description: AR path guidance derives from VAM-HRI interface concepts.
relations.design_implication: 视觉化不可见计划。

relations.description: AR path guidance should be evaluated by situation awareness.
relations.design_implication: 测量理解而非只看美观。

relations.description: AR may reduce or increase workload.
relations.design_implication: 比较遮挡和负荷。

relations.description: Service recovery opportunity derives from failure recovery.
relations.design_implication: 设计失败解释和人工转接。

relations.description: Failure recovery design should be evaluated by recovery metrics.
relations.design_implication: 记录恢复时间和满意度。

relations.description: Failure recovery affects trust.
relations.design_implication: 失败后信任变化很关键。

relations.description: The mediator opportunity depends on LLM agent layer.
relations.design_implication: 任务要经过可执行性检查。

relations.description: LLM robot mediator requires transparent plan and limits.
relations.design_implication: 显示为何不能执行。

relations.description: Cobot intent UI derives from legibility concerns.
relations.design_implication: 把目标和下一步动作可视化。

relations.description: Cobot intent UI must respect safety constraints.
relations.design_implication: 设计不能鼓励危险靠近。

relations.description: Research question follows autonomy-trust relationship.
relations.design_implication: 适合实验研究。

relations.description: Research question follows AR path guidance opportunity.
relations.design_implication: 适合 poster。

relations.description: GraphRAG extends design knowledge reuse with graph structure.
relations.design_implication: 让 LLM 根据关系生成机会。

relations.description: GraphRAG can retrieve related concepts and sources for AR opportunities.
relations.design_implication: 提升机会生成可追溯性。

relations.description: GraphRAG can generate research questions from autonomy and trust relations.
relations.design_implication: 辅助论文选题。

relations.description: Situated action frames service workflows as adaptive rather than fixed scripts.
relations.design_implication: 机器人要处理现场变化。

relations.description: Embodied interaction applies to physical collaboration with cobots.
relations.design_implication: 动作和空间本身是界面。

relations.description: Multimodal feedback can improve awareness if well integrated.
relations.design_implication: 避免信息过载。

relations.description: Voice is common in home assistant scenarios.
relations.design_implication: 必须处理澄清和隐私。

relations.description: Gesture can support spatial instructions in assembly.
relations.design_implication: 嘈杂场景中补充语音。

relations.description: Haptic feedback can support remote inspection and teleoperation.
relations.design_implication: 提示接触和风险。

relations.description: Tangible interfaces materialize affordances.
relations.design_implication: 让任务边界可触摸。

relations.description: Intention recognition depends on perception data.
relations.design_implication: 识别错误应可解释。

relations.description: Navigation behavior influences safety and comfort.
relations.design_implication: 路径和速度是交互变量。

relations.description: Users need to understand navigation decisions in shared spaces.
relations.design_implication: 显示绕路和等待原因。

relations.description: Perception uncertainty is hard for users to see.
relations.design_implication: 需要状态和置信度表达。

relations.description: Museum guidance can use gaze cues for joint attention.
relations.design_implication: 帮助游客跟随讲解。

relations.description: Rehabilitation training benefits from haptic/physical feedback.
relations.design_implication: 反馈需舒适和安全。

relations.description: Home assistants need user agency and privacy controls.
relations.design_implication: 家庭场景要可拒绝和可关闭。
